AL.name: Alabama
AL.homeschool_note: Notice via church school or private tutor option; no testing.
AL.zoning_note: Statewide rule not confirmed. Baldwin County zones only planning districts whose voters opt in by election; the county notes unzoned communities exist.
AL.zoning_source_name: Baldwin County, AL - Planning and Zoning District Elections

AK.name: Alaska
AK.homeschool_note: Homeschool statute needs no notice, testing, or qualifications.
AK.zoning_note: First and second class boroughs must provide areawide planning and land use regulation. Land outside organized boroughs forms one unorganized borough with no borough government.

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.homeschool_note: One-time affidavit to county; no testing.
AZ.right_to_farm_note: 2021: mandatory fee award against bad-faith nuisance suits.
AZ.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed with permit; utilities add solar-owner fees (2023 source).
AZ.zoning_note: Every county must adopt a comprehensive plan (A.R.S. 11-804); zoning is permissive ('may', A.R.S. 11-811). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
AR.zoning_note: County planning boards may prepare a zoning ordinance for all or part of the unincorporated area; no mandate. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

CA.name: California
CA.homeschool_note: File private school affidavit; no testing.
CA.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; proper-cause ended after Bruen; no nonresident permits.
CA.rainwater_note: Rainwater Capture Act 2012: rooftop capture needs no water right.
CA.income_tax_note: Includes 1% surcharge above $1M; plus 1.1% payroll tax.
CA.zoning_note: Every county must adopt a general plan (Gov. Code 65300); zoning ordinances are permissive (65850). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.homeschool_note: Notice plus testing or evaluation in set grades.
CO.rainwater_note: Two barrels, 110 gal total, outdoor use only; rural exempt-well permit option.
CO.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed but septic usually still required; tiny homes on wheels treated as RVs.
CO.zoning_note: County planning commissions have a duty to adopt a master plan (30-28-106); zoning plans are permissive unless the board orders one (30-28-111). Count not confirmed.

CT.name: Connecticut
CT.homeschool_note: No notice now; new law effective 2027 under HSLDA challenge.
CT.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows few provisions; weaker statute.
CT.offgrid_note: Towns may require sewer connection; occupancy cannot be denied for alternative power.
CT.zoning_note: No county government. Any town or city may adopt the zoning chapter by vote and act through a zoning commission. Share of rural towns without zoning not confirmed.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
DE.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; nonresident permits rarely issued.
DE.zoning_note: Each of the three counties has its own zoning chapter in Title 9 (ch. 26 New Castle, ch. 49 Kent, ch. 69 Sussex).

DC.name: District of Columbia
DC.homeschool_note: Notice and parent high-school diploma; no testing.
DC.right_to_farm_note: No right-to-farm statute; not a state.
DC.rainwater_note: Not covered by sources read; assumed allowed.

FL.name: Florida
FL.homeschool_note: Home-education statute needs notice and annual evaluation; umbrella school avoids both.
FL.carry_note: Permitless since July 1, 2023; open-carry ban struck Sept 2025.
FL.right_to_farm_note: 2022: losing plaintiff pays farm's costs and fees.
FL.offgrid_note: Sewer connection mandatory where available; composting toilet alone not enough.
FL.zoning_note: Every county must maintain a comprehensive plan (163.3167) and must adopt land development regulations implementing it (163.3202).

GA.name: Georgia
GA.homeschool_note: Notice, parent diploma, and periodic testing required.
GA.right_to_farm_note: Standing limited to owners of affected property.
GA.zoning_note: State law recognizes local governments' zoning power and sets procedures; it does not require zoning. Planning updates are required only for state funding eligibility. Count not confirmed.
GA.zoning_source_name: Ga. Code 36-66-2 (Zoning Procedures Law); Georgia DCA Local Planning page

HI.name: Hawaii
HI.homeschool_note: Notice plus testing in set grades.
HI.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; permits valid only in issuing county.
HI.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows few provisions; weaker statute.
HI.zoning_note: The state Land Use Commission places all land in the state in urban, rural, agricultural or conservation districts (HRS 205-2); counties zone within that (HRS 46-4).

ID.name: Idaho
ID.zoning_note: Each governing board shall by ordinance establish zoning districts consistent with its comprehensive plan (Local Land Use Planning Act).

IL.name: Illinois
IL.carry_note: Permit required; permitless only for unloaded cased firearms.
IL.zoning_note: County boards have power to zone land outside municipalities; no mandate, and agricultural land is largely exempt from permits. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

IN.name: Indiana
IN.zoning_note: The county legislative body has exclusive authority to adopt a zoning ordinance, only after a comprehensive plan; no mandate. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

IA.name: Iowa
IA.homeschool_note: Independent private instruction option needs no notice or testing.
IA.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows many provisions; broad statute.
IA.zoning_note: Boards of supervisors may zone land outside city limits; farms and farm buildings are exempt (335.2). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

KS.name: Kansas
KS.homeschool_note: One-time registration as private school; HSLDA lists periodic assessment.
KS.zoning_note: K.S.A. 12-741 is enabling legislation for city and county planning and zoning; adoption is optional. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

KY.name: Kentucky
KY.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
KY.zoning_note: Zoning requires a planning unit and adopted comprehensive plan first; then fiscal courts 'may' enact zoning (KRS 100.113, 100.201). Count not confirmed.

LA.name: Louisiana
LA.homeschool_note: Registered private school option: notice only, no testing.
LA.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows many provisions; broad statute.
LA.zoning_note: Parish governing authorities are authorized, not required, to zone; four parishes are excluded from the general act. Count of zoned parishes not confirmed.

ME.name: Maine
ME.zoning_note: Municipalities may enact zoning (30-A M.R.S. 4352). The state Land Use Planning Commission sets land use districts and standards for the unorganized territory (12 M.R.S. 685-A).

MD.name: Maryland
MD.homeschool_note: Notice; no testing or qualifications listed.
MD.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; good-and-substantial-reason ended after Bruen.
MD.zoning_note: State policy is that planning and zoning controls are implemented by local government (Land Use 4-101); legislative bodies 'may' regulate land use (4-102). County count not confirmed.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.homeschool_note: Notice to local school committee plus periodic assessment.
MA.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; place and purpose limits remain.
MA.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed since 2016 with board of health approval; many towns mandate sewer.
MA.income_tax_note: Graduated; 4% surtax on income over about $1M.
MA.zoning_note: Zoning is defined as ordinances and bylaws adopted by cities and towns; counties play no role. Share of rural towns without zoning not confirmed.

MI.name: Michigan
MI.homeschool_note: Home-school option needs no notice or testing.
MI.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows many provisions; broad statute.
MI.zoning_note: Townships, cities, villages and counties may zone; a township with its own ordinance is exempt from county zoning (MCL 125.3209). Share of rural townships without zoning not confirmed.
MI.zoning_source_name: Michigan Zoning Enabling Act, MCL 125.3201 and 125.3209

MN.name: Minnesota
MN.homeschool_note: Notice, parent qualifications, and annual testing.
MN.zoning_note: Counties are authorized to plan and zone (394.21). If a county fails to adopt a shoreland ordinance the state imposes a model one (103F.215). Count of general zoning not confirmed.

MS.name: Mississippi
MS.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
MS.carry_note: Permitless in holster, sheath, or bag; other concealment needs permit.
MS.zoning_note: County governing authorities may, in their discretion, regulate land use in unincorporated areas; agriculture and forestry need no permits. Count not confirmed.

MO.name: Missouri
MO.homeschool_note: No notice; HSLDA lists record-keeping/assessment requirement.
MO.carry_note: Permitless since Jan 1, 2017; open carry may be locally restricted.
MO.right_to_farm_note: Constitution Art. I Sec. 35 (2014) guarantees right to farm.
MO.offgrid_note: Many rural counties have no zoning or building codes; approved septic still required.
MO.zoning_note: County zoning may start only after voters approve the ballot question 'Shall county zoning be adopted?' (RSMo 64.845). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

MT.name: Montana
MT.homeschool_note: Annual notice to county; no testing.
MT.zoning_note: A board that has adopted a growth policy is authorized, not required, to zone all or part of its jurisdictional area (MCA 76-2-201). Count not confirmed.

NE.name: Nebraska
NE.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
NE.zoning_note: County boards have power to adopt a zoning resolution, only after a comprehensive development plan (23-114, 23-114.03); no mandate. Count not confirmed.

NV.name: Nevada
NV.homeschool_note: One-time notice; no testing or qualifications.
NV.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows few provisions; weaker statute.
NV.rainwater_note: NRS 533.027: de minimis rooftop capture, single-family home, nonpotable use.
NV.zoning_note: Planning commissions shall prepare a master plan (NRS 278.150); governing bodies 'may' divide the county into zoning districts (278.250). Count not confirmed.

NH.name: New Hampshire
NH.income_tax_note: No wage tax; interest and dividends tax repealed 2025.
NH.zoning_note: Cities and towns are authorized to adopt zoning; counties only for unincorporated places. Share of rural towns without zoning not confirmed.

NJ.name: New Jersey
NJ.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; justifiable-need ended after Bruen; strict place limits.
NJ.zoning_note: The municipal governing body may adopt a zoning ordinance after the planning board adopts the master plan's land use element; counties do not zone.

NM.name: New Mexico
NM.homeschool_note: Notice and parent high-school diploma; no testing.
NM.carry_note: Permit required; unloaded concealed or loaded in vehicle allowed without.
NM.zoning_note: A county zoning authority may regulate land use and divide its territory into districts; no mandate. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

NY.name: New York
NY.homeschool_note: Notice, mandated subjects, and annual assessment; likely rated high by HSLDA.
NY.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; NYC permits separate; many sensitive-place limits.
NY.rainwater_note: Large cisterns may need local permit.
NY.zoning_note: Town boards are empowered to zone the part of the town outside villages; counties do not zone. Share of rural towns without zoning not confirmed.

NC.name: North Carolina
NC.homeschool_note: Notice, parent diploma, and annual standardized test.
NC.right_to_farm_note: Updated after 2018; defense failed in Smithfield hog cases.
NC.zoning_note: Counties may zone under G.S. 160D. UNC survey: 79 of 100 counties had adopted zoning (countywide or partial) by 2012; all counties with over 50,000 unincorporated residents zone.
NC.zoning_source_name: UNC School of Government, 2012 Zoning Survey Report (Owens and Batten)

ND.name: North Dakota
ND.homeschool_note: Notice, parent qualifications, and testing with exceptions.
ND.carry_note: Concealed only; carry state ID and inform police; open carry needs permit.
ND.right_to_farm_note: Constitutional right-to-farm (2012) reported; not confirmed this session.
ND.zoning_note: Boards of county commissioners may regulate the location and use of buildings and land (NDCC 11-33-01); no mandate. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

OH.name: Ohio
OH.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
OH.income_tax_note: Flat above $26,050 from 2026; local taxes excluded.
OH.zoning_note: Zoning outside cities is by township (ORC 519.02); county rural zoning applies only in townships whose voters approve it (303.11). Share of unzoned townships not confirmed.

OK.name: Oklahoma
OK.income_tax_note: Graduated; brackets cut to three in 2026.
OK.zoning_note: County planning and zoning requires a board resolution and a majority vote of county electors (19 O.S. 865.52); covers unincorporated areas only. Count not confirmed.

OR.name: Oregon
OR.homeschool_note: Notice plus testing in set grades.
OR.carry_note: Permit required; recognizes only CA, ID, NV, WA residents.
OR.rainwater_note: ORS 537.141(1)(h): rooftop capture exempt from water-right permit.
OR.offgrid_note: Farm/forest zoning sets 20-160 acre minimum parcels; composting toilets allowed since 1978.
OR.zoning_note: Each city and county shall adopt a comprehensive plan meeting statewide goals and enact land use regulations to implement it.

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.homeschool_note: Home-education program: notice, parent diploma, annual evaluation and portfolio.
PA.zoning_note: Zoning is by municipality; county zoning applies only to land in municipalities with no zoning ordinance of their own (MPC s. 602). Share of unzoned rural municipalities not confirmed.
PA.zoning_source_name: Pennsylvania Municipalities Planning Code (Act 247 of 1968), s. 602

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.homeschool_note: Notice; HSLDA lists no assessment requirement.
RI.carry_note: Formerly may-issue for municipal permits; AG permits also issued.
RI.zoning_note: No county government. Zoning ordinances are adopted by cities and towns under Title 45, ch. 24.

SC.name: South Carolina
SC.homeschool_note: Parent diploma required; association option avoids district notice and testing.
SC.zoning_note: County councils may create planning commissions and may adopt zoning after a comprehensive plan (6-29-320, 6-29-720); no mandate. Count not confirmed.
SC.zoning_source_name: S.C. Code Title 6, ch. 29 (Comprehensive Planning Enabling Act)

SD.name: South Dakota
SD.zoning_note: The board of county commissioners may adopt a zoning ordinance (SDCL 11-2-13); no mandate. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.homeschool_note: Notice and parent diploma; testing only for independent option.
TN.offgrid_note: Composting toilets barred where running water exists unless wastewater system approved.
TN.zoning_note: County legislative bodies are authorized to regulate land outside municipalities (T.C.A. 13-7-101); permissive. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

TX.name: Texas
TX.homeschool_note: No notice; home schools treated as private schools.
TX.carry_note: Permitless since Sept 1, 2021; handguns; holster for open carry.
TX.right_to_farm_note: Bars nuisance suits against operations running one year unchanged.
TX.rainwater_note: Sales-tax exempt equipment; HOAs cannot ban systems.
TX.offgrid_note: Few codes in unincorporated areas; composting toilets legal; rainwater may be potable.
TX.zoning_note: Counties have no general zoning power. Chapter 231 gives narrow exceptions: Padre Island (Cameron, Willacy), Amistad area of Val Verde County, named lake areas, Falcon Lake, Lake Somerville, military zones.
TX.zoning_source_name: Texas Local Government Code ch. 231 (County Zoning Authority)

UT.name: Utah
UT.homeschool_note: One-time notice; no testing or mandated subjects.
UT.rainwater_note: Two 100-gal containers unregistered; free registration up to 2,500 gal.
UT.zoning_note: Each county shall adopt a general plan (17-27a-401) and the legislative body shall adopt a land use regulation creating zoning districts and their allowed uses (17-27a-501).

VT.name: Vermont
VT.offgrid_note: Composting toilets named in law; septic still likely; solar under 15 kW needs registration only.
VT.zoning_note: A municipality may regulate land development through zoning bylaws in conformance with its plan; counties do not zone. Share of towns without zoning not confirmed.

VA.name: Virginia
VA.homeschool_note: Home-instruction option: notice plus annual evidence of progress.
VA.right_to_farm_note: Standing limited to owners of affected property.
VA.zoning_note: Every locality shall adopt a comprehensive plan (15.2-2223); zoning is permissive ('any locality may', 15.2-2280). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

WA.name: Washington
WA.homeschool_note: Notice, parent qualifications, and annual testing.
WA.carry_note: Permit required; permitless only during outdoor recreation.
WA.rainwater_note: Rooftop capture needs no water right; use on site.
WA.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed with health permit; some counties allow rainwater as drinking water.
WA.income_tax_note: No wage tax; 7%-9% tax on large capital gains.
WA.zoning_note: Fast-growing counties must plan and adopt development regulations under the GMA; every county must adopt critical-areas regulations (36.70A.060). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

WV.name: West Virginia
WV.homeschool_note: Notice and parent diploma; assessment depends on option.
WV.right_to_farm_note: 2019: plaintiff must own land within half mile; no punitive damages.
WV.zoning_note: County commissions 'may' adopt a zoning ordinance (8A-7-1); a petition by 10 percent of voters forces an election on it (8A-7-7). Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

WI.name: Wisconsin
WI.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
WI.zoning_note: Every county must zone its unincorporated shorelands (59.692). General county zoning takes effect in a town only after the town board approves it (59.69(5)(c)). Town-level share not confirmed.

WY.name: Wyoming
WY.homeschool_note: No notice, testing, or qualifications; curriculum form optional.
WY.zoning_note: Each board of county commissioners 'may' regulate land use in the unincorporated area (W.S. 18-5-201); no mandate. Count of zoned counties not confirmed.

state_sources.amish_method: Amish rows are the Young Center's 2026 state/county/settlement table, parsed verbatim (705 settlements; the district total of 3,229 matches the Young Center's published US total). A settlement the source lists under several counties (including cross-state counties such as 'St. Joseph MI') gets one row per county with the same name; the source does not split districts by county, so 'districts' is the settlement total divided evenly across its counties (fractional where needed) and 'settlement_districts' keeps the unsplit total. County FIPS were matched by state and county name against the Census 2023 gazetteer; four source spellings were corrected (Lousia->Louisa IA, Onedia->Oneida NY, Connejos->Conejos CO, Lyons->Lyon KS) and Van Wert, listed without a state suffix under Indiana's Adams County settlement, was assigned to Ohio. One source row (Cold Spring, Jefferson WI) has no district figure, so districts is null. Old Order / horse-and-buggy Mennonite rows are a PARTIAL list: the Young Center publishes these settlements only as state-level counts by group (about 60 US settlements across 8 groups), so the 33 county rows here were assembled from a 2014 JAPAS Kentucky table, a 2019 JAPAS New York profile, GAMEO and Wikipedia; where a source named only a town, the county is the town's county. Mennonite 'districts' are null (congregation counts were not available at settlement level). Beachy/Amish-Mennonite and other car-driving groups are excluded.
